name: facedoodle
description: FaceDoodle — deface your friends (lovingly) with animated demonic doodles.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
